description:
s7 as amended. papers/<citekey>/kovan.toml + papers/<citekey>/<citekey>.md. kovan.toml carries: schema_version, id (= the BibTeX citekey, NO separate citekey field), kind = "paper", [source] access = open|restricted + pdf path, [classification] topics[] + projects[]. Papers may belong to many classifications but MUST belong to at least one -- provide an 'Unsorted' inbox classification for rapid ingestion.

BLOCKED on op-k25f (kopitiam-bibliography, unpublished, maintainer publishing as v0.0.1). Citekey-as-id needs a real BibTeX PARSER to enforce uniqueness at ingestion; this workspace has none today (kovan_literature::bibtex::to_bibtex renders one-way only -- op-b1y5's documented v1 limitation, which currently joins pdf/<stem>.pdf to markdown/<stem>.md by filename stem instead).

Citekeys are not guaranteed filesystem-safe (hand-typed keys can carry punctuation). Validate/sanitise before a citekey becomes a directory name; auto-generated keys like wang2018multiphysics already are.
title: kovan redesign 05: paper directory + paper kovan.toml with citekey-as-id

description:
The turbine's energy sink term must be SHAFT WORK, not a prescribed heat sink, and it must feed the rotor inertia ODE J domega/dt = T_turb - T_gen. Without that coupling the twin cannot do load rejection or overspeed, which is the transient a turbine twin exists for.

ThreePhaseElectricGeneratorTurbine (tampines-steam-tables/src/steam_turbine_equations/generator.rs) is a working lumped electromechanical rotor — torque balance, omega, EMF, current, power — but it takes torque as a FREE INPUT and has no steam path. This bead closes that loop: steam expansion supplies the torque.

Two design constraints from the 2026-08-04 review:
- Do NOT give the turbine CV real blade-path fluid inventory. Steam residence time is milliseconds; a CV with true blade volume adds a stiff acoustic mode that shrinks the timestep for no physics. Model the turbine as a quasi-steady junction (flow law + work extraction) between volumes, with storage in the steam chest and adjacent pipes. If the CV has volume, it represents the chest/casing.
- Casing heat loss is a genuine SECOND sink but is small (order 0.5-1 percent) — optional.

Scope context: crates/tampines-steam-tables/docs/validation-scope-turbine-and-pipe.md section 1.
title: tampines Turbine: couple the shaft-work sink to rotor inertia and the generator

description:
Surfaced 2026-08-13 by a new test comparing the literal against critical_insertion_fraction. PRE-EXISTING, not introduced by the secondary-controls work. Documented on the constant and deliberately NOT changed.

GUI_INITIAL_ROD_INSERTION = 0.6035. A bisection puts critical at 0.604535. So the simulator's opening state commands
+0.0435 dollars = +28.3 pcm of excess reactivity -- the plant is very slightly supercritical the moment it opens,
rather than sitting at the critical insertion the constant's name implies.

Far below prompt critical, so it is not a stability problem; it means the opening state drifts up slowly instead of
holding, and anyone reading the constant reasonably assumes it is the critical value.

WHY IT WAS LEFT ALONE, and why this is a maintainer decision rather than an obvious fix: every V&V number recorded
against the opening state was measured AT 0.6035. Changing it to 0.604535 moves the whole-plant smoke test, the
20 s timing test, the 150 s run, the corrector sweep and the command-envelope corners. That is a coordinated
re-measurement, not a one-character edit.

TWO WAYS TO RESOLVE, pick one:
  (a) Set the constant to the computed critical insertion and re-measure every V&V figure that references the
      opening state, updating each doc comment with the new number and date.
  (b) Keep 0.6035 and RENAME it so it stops implying criticality (e.g. GUI_INITIAL_ROD_INSERTION_SLIGHTLY_SUPERCRITICAL),
      documenting the +28.3 pcm as deliberate -- a plant opening with a little excess reactivity is a defensible
      teaching state.
Either is fine; the current situation -- a name that claims critical and a value that is not -- is the part worth
fixing.

Related: op-szmi.7 (control-rod insertion control + sourced feedback coefficient), op-szmi.15 (temperature
coefficient 2.1x too weak).
title: htgr_sim_v1 opens SLIGHTLY SUPERCRITICAL: rod insertion 0.6035 vs critical 0.604535 (+28.3 pcm)
